The mount is just a thick nylon strap with a small screw and washer(so you get play and momentum the length of the strap). The anchors I have aren't like that. They're a metal bracket that you affix to the wall and then affix to the furniture. There's no play.

Side note: ovens always come with a locking slide to lock down the rear foot of the oven so it doesn't tip forward. I never understood why this was such a big deal - was there an epidemic of ovens falling over on people?
